note: 21 hook formulas for X. On X the first line is not the start of the post, it is most of the post: the timeline shows a standard post whole, and a long one only until 'Show more'. So the hook has to be complete on its own, readable in the time it takes a thumb to decide, and specific enough that nobody else could have posted it. Every formula carries a template, a filled example, what it is for, the way it usually gets ruined, and a `match` regex so the same vocabulary can name a hook found in the wild, not only write a new one. Walk them in `classify_order`, most specific first, case-insensitive.
rules: The first line has to work if it is the only line anybody reads. On X it usually is.
One idea. If the line needs a comma splice, it is two posts.
Numbers beat adjectives. '$4,200' beats 'a lot of money' every time.
No label as the hook. 'A thread', 'Hot take', 'Quick one' are packaging. Lead with the thing inside.
No link, no hashtag and no @ in line 1. A link there is an exit before the post has landed, and a hashtag is a link out of your own post.
If the hook would work with anybody else's name on it, it is not your hook.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. {Specific experience} says otherwise.
hooks.example: Everyone says post three times a day. My best month on here was eight posts.
hooks.best_for: A point of view. The highest reply rate of the 21, and replies are what X weighs.
hooks.trap: Being contrarian about something nobody believes. The belief has to be genuinely common, or it is a straw man and the replies will say so.
hooks.match: \b(?:unpopular opinion|hot take|controversial|everyone (?:says|thinks|tells you|is wrong)|most people (?:think|believe|say)|stop (?:telling|saying)|is (?:overrated|a lie|dead)|nobody wants to hear)\b

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here's what actually happened.
hooks.example: I replied to 30 accounts bigger than me every day for 60 days. Here's what it did.
hooks.best_for: Experiments and challenges. Anything with a countable result.
hooks.trap: Burying the result. The number that matters goes in line 1 or line 2, not post 7.

hooks.name: Cost Confession
hooks.template: {Specific amount} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause cost me.
hooks.best_for: Trust, fast. People repost the ones where you look bad.
hooks.trap: A fake cost. 'It cost me my peace of mind' is not a number and everybody can hear that.

hooks.name: Before / After
hooks.template: {Time} ago I {low state}. Today I {high state}. One thing changed.
hooks.example: A year ago I had 212 followers. Today I have 9,400. I changed one habit.
hooks.best_for: Proof you have travelled the distance your reader wants to travel.
hooks.trap: Three-part transformations. Name one lever or nobody believes any of them.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.template: {N} {things} {specific audience} should {do/know}:
hooks.example: 7 prompts I use every single day as a solo founder:
hooks.best_for: Bookmarks. A list is the post people save to read later, and a bookmark is a signal you can see in your analytics.
hooks.trap: N above 10. Nobody believes you have 15 good ones, and you do not.

hooks.name: Nobody Tells You
hooks.template: Nobody tells you {true, specific, slightly uncomfortable thing}.
hooks.example: Nobody tells you this about growing on X.
hooks.best_for: Insider knowledge from someone who has done the thing.
hooks.trap: Following it with something everybody already tells you. The comments will quote it back.

hooks.name: The Hottest New
hooks.template: The hottest new {familiar category} is {unexpected thing}.
hooks.example: The hottest new marketing hire is a skill file.
hooks.best_for: Reframing. One sentence, no setup, that makes the reader see a category differently. The most reposted shape on AI Twitter.
hooks.trap: A reframe that is not true enough to argue with. It has to be defensible, or it is just a slogan.

hooks.name: Credential Setup
hooks.template: I'm {name} and I {built / run / did the thing}. Here's my exact setup.
hooks.example: I'm Dana and I run a 7-figure agency with 4 people. Here's my exact stack.
hooks.best_for: When who you are is the reason to read. Works only if the credential is real and specific.
hooks.trap: A credential that is not one. 'I'm a creator who loves AI' is not a reason to keep reading.

hooks.name: Time Anchor
hooks.template: {Task} used to take me {long time}. It now takes {short time}.
hooks.example: A client proposal used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.
hooks.best_for: Automation and tooling posts. The ratio does the persuading.
hooks.trap: An unbelievable ratio. 5 hours to 20 minutes lands; 5 hours to 5 seconds reads as an ad.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.template: {A specific person} {did something surprising} with {specific tool/approach}.
hooks.example: I watched a founder build his whole onboarding flow on a call in 40 minutes.
hooks.best_for: Borrowed proof, told first-hand. Lower ego than your own result, often more believed.
hooks.trap: A result you cannot vouch for. If you did not see it, it is a rumour, and a rumour with a number in it is worse.

hooks.name: The Prediction
hooks.template: In {timeframe}, {specific change} will {happen}. {Why, in one line}.
hooks.example: In 18 months, no agency will sell a retainer without a skill file.
hooks.best_for: Positioning. A dated, falsifiable call people come back to quote.
hooks.trap: A prediction that cannot be wrong. 'AI will change everything' is not a prediction.
hooks.match: \b(?:in (?:\d+|a few|two|three|five|ten|eighteen) (?:months?|years?)|by (?:20\d\d|next year|the end of)|within (?:a|\d+) (?:years?|months?))\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}\b(?:will|won'?t|is going to|are going to)\b|\bmark my words\b|\bcalling it\b

hooks.name: The Command
hooks.template: {Imperative verb} {specific thing}. {The reason, in one line}.
hooks.example: Delete the first line of every post you draft. It's almost always throat-clearing.
hooks.best_for: Teaching in one move. Short, useful, bookmarkable.
hooks.trap: A command with no reason. 'Stop using ChatGPT.' Why? The reason is the post.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.template: {Surprising figure} of {group} {do something}. {What it means}.
hooks.example: 3 of my last 40 posts brought in 71% of my new followers.
hooks.best_for: Authority, when the number is real and you can show where it came from. Your own analytics count.
hooks.trap: A made-up or unsourced stat. On X somebody will ask for the source in under a minute.

hooks.name: The Coinage
hooks.template: There's a new kind of {activity} I call "{name}". {What it is}.
hooks.example: There's a new kind of job I call "agent wrangling". Half my week is it now.
hooks.best_for: Naming a thing people are already doing without a word for it. When it lands, the name travels further than the post.
hooks.trap: Naming something that already has a name. The replies will link the Wikipedia page.
hooks.match: \bi (?:call|called|'ve been calling|have been calling)\b|\bwhat i call\b|\ba new kind of\b|\bthere'?s a name for\b

hooks.name: The Launch
hooks.template: {New thing} just {shipped/launched}. {The one detail that matters}.
hooks.example: Claude Code just shipped plugins. You can install a whole team's workflow in one command.
hooks.best_for: News, first. On X being early is worth more than being thorough.
hooks.trap: Siren emoji and 'BREAKING' on something that is not. It works once.

hooks.name: Thread Promise
hooks.template: I {spent N hours doing specific thing}. Here's everything I learned:
hooks.example: I read every post that got 1M+ views in my niche last month. Here's what they had in common:
hooks.best_for: Threads. The first post sells the whole thread, so it has to promise a specific payoff.
hooks.trap: 'A thread 🧵' as the hook. That is a label. The payoff is the hook.

hooks.name: The Regret
hooks.template: I wasted {time} on {thing}. {What you'd do instead}.
hooks.example: I wasted two years posting to nobody. Replies would have got me there in six months.
hooks.best_for: Saving the reader the same mistake. Humility without a price tag on it.
hooks.trap: A regret that is secretly a brag. 'I wish I'd raised less' reads exactly how it sounds.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.template: {Expensive/known option} vs {cheap/new option}. {Which won and by how much}.
hooks.example: A $12,000 agency retainer vs a weekend with Claude. The weekend won.
hooks.best_for: Decisions your audience is actually making.
hooks.trap: A rigged fight. If the loser is a straw man, nobody learns anything and the loser's fans reply.

hooks.name: Field Report
hooks.template: I've been {spending time with specific group} lately. {What you noticed that others haven't}.
hooks.example: I've been sitting in on agency sales calls lately. Nobody asks about price anymore.
hooks.best_for: Observation from the inside. The post is the noticing.
hooks.trap: A report with no observation in it. 'Been talking to founders, the vibes are shifting' says nothing.

hooks.name: The Open Question
hooks.template: {Specific question only your audience can answer}?
hooks.example: What's the one $20/month tool you'd cancel last?
hooks.best_for: Replies. A good question is the cheapest way to fill a thread, and the answers are next week's research.
hooks.trap: A question anybody could ask. 'Thoughts?' and 'What do you think about AI?' get nothing.

hooks.name: The One-Liner
hooks.template: {One true, short sentence. No setup.}
hooks.example: Your first 1,000 followers come from replies, not posts.
hooks.best_for: Posts that are complete in one line and meant to be quoted. The shape of most of the biggest posts on the platform.
hooks.trap: A one-liner that is only a vibe. It has to be a claim somebody could disagree with.
